question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Q3 2026 operating income guide is $22.5-26.5B. Amazon historically beats the top of its guide; Q2 core operating income was $27.5B. At OI of about $26-29B, other income of about +$0-1B, a tax rate near 20% and 10.9B diluted shares, core GAAP EPS is about $2.00-2.15, versus a sell-side consensus of $1.96-2.03. The Anthropic IPO is expected late October (Q4), and no Anthropic equity round priced inside Q3 was found, so the base case has no large Anthropic mark. Upper escape (~10%): an observable-price event for Anthropic or OpenAI preferred stock in Q3 (facility draws, strategic sales), where gains of $11B+ would push EPS above $3. Market check: Polymarket 'AMZN beat GAAP EPS' is at 60% Yes on about $1.2k volume; it is a beat-vs-consensus contract, not this numeric question, so I treated it as weak evidence. No Kalshi or bookmaker market was found.
calls.dossier:
- Amazon Q2 2026 8-K (Jul 2026): diluted EPS $5.75, net income $62.6B, diluted shares 10,903M, operating income $27.5B, other income $53.4B (Anthropic preferred upward adjustments $50.5B; marketable equity gains $1.3B; warrant gains $1.4B; FX $0.2B).
- Q1 2026 diluted EPS $2.78 (from $8.53 six-month total minus $5.75), which included a $16.8B Anthropic gain (thenextweb). Q3 2025 diluted EPS $1.95 (included about $9.5B Anthropic gain and about $4.3B of FTC and severance charges).
- Q3 2026 guidance: net sales $197-202B; operating income $22.5-26.5B (Q3 2025 OI $17.4B). Prime Day fell in Q2 2026 vs Q3 2025.
- Sell-side consensus Q3 2026 EPS: about $1.96-2.03 (TipRanks 1.96; Barchart/Yahoo 2.02; Plus500 2.03). Q2 2026 consensus was $1.82; core ex-Anthropic Q2 EPS was about $2.2.
- 10-Q accounting: Anthropic nonvoting preferred is marked to fair value on observable price changes, with gains in other income; convertible notes are available-for-sale debt with changes in other comprehensive income (not EPS). Amazon bought $5B Series G + $5B Series H in Q2; $15B remains on a $20B facility with draws tied to AWS compute milestones. Six-month 2026 effective tax rate 23%.
- Subsequent event (10-Q): after Jun 30, Amazon issued $25B of notes and invested $21.3B in OpenAI Series C preferred stock (could produce marks if OpenAI raises at a different price).
- Anthropic: Series H at $965B (May 2026); confidential S-1 filed Jun 1, 2026; IPO expected late October 2026 at a $1.8-2T+ valuation, i.e. Q4, after the Sept 30 quarter end (Reuters via secondary sites, Fortune Aug 13 2026). As of late Sept still private; $15B credit line expansion in Sept (debt, not equity).
- Searched for but did not find any Anthropic equity round or priced transaction dated Jul-Sep 2026; an '$852B Aug tender' claim turned out to be OpenAI, not Anthropic.
- Status quo: no large investment mark, so EPS comes from operations plus routine equity/warrant swings of about +/-$1-3B.
- Resolution: resolves off Amazon's Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K, ~Oct 29, 2026), GAAP diluted EPS, not adjusted or consensus figures.
- Event window: quarter Jul 1 -> Sep 30, 2026 (closed); report due Oct 29, 2026; as of Oct 17 the quarter is 100% elapsed, report not yet released.
